author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
How many tasks you can work in parallel depends on how often you get interrupted by AI.  

If you can build the harness to let AI agent runs on its own for a whole day, you only have to schedule a 30 minutes 1-on-1 status meeting with it every day, then you can command over 10 AI agents in parallel.

If your AI agents keep interrupting you every 15 minutes, you can't multi-task and pay attention to more than a few agents without frying your brain.
